mechanism_narrative: A higher current CPIAUCSL reading (inflation) compresses real equity valuations by increasing the real discount rate, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in less than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL is above its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 0.1% signals an imminent monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises above 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) and declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100.0) indicates an overheating economy with supply constraints, triggering a market correction that produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 30% of instances when both UNRATE < 4.0% and INDPRO < 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 255.0), a higher unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals economic weakness that reduces corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 35% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 255.0 and UNRATE is above its 12-month average.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1,000,000 units (HOUST < 1000.0) indicates a contraction in the residential sector, reducing consumer confidence and corporate capital expenditure, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when HOUST < 1000.0.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production exceeds 102.0 (a 2% increase from the 2017 base), it signals strong economic momentum that supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when INDPRO > 102.0.

mechanism_narrative: A higher current residential sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer spending and housing market activity, which supports economic growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when RSAFS is above its 12-month average.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 6.0% signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in less than 35% of instances when UNRATE > 6.0%.
